newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in quiet activity.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mixed on Wednesday amid lackluster activity but dealers cited some concerns about the shortened Thanksgiving holiday week.
People are preparing mentally for the (Thanksgiving) holiday next week which would cause some short run times, a Buffalo dealer said.
"A lot of people were still concerned about how we are going to get through next week being a holiday week," another dealer said.
But he noted "it was more of a logistical thing than anything else."
He added many flour mills were taking downtimes and that most feed mills would be running everyday except Thanksgiving, November 28.
"Most of the flour mills will be taking off Thursday through Sunday," he said.
Dealers also said that nearby demand has improved. "We are pretty much sold out for this week and next week with the last trade at $94.00 (a ton for spot November)," a St Louis dealer said.

A Texas dealer agreed. "It is just all nearby business, that is all anybody wants to do until it gets real cold down here," he said, referring to the 80 degree (Fahrenheit) temperatures sweeping over most of the state.
